content.short: Payset is a UK multi-currency business account platform with virtual IBANs and FX across 34 currencies.
content.description: Payset is a UK-based, London-headquartered financial platform offering multi-currency business accounts and cross-border payments for internationally active companies. Regulated as an electronic money institution by the UK FCA, it lets businesses hold and manage 34 currencies, open virtual IBANs, collect and send international payments, and exchange across dozens of currency pairs from one dashboard. Payset targets startups, founders, SMBs, import-export firms and travel companies that trade across markets and need to receive, convert and pay in multiple currencies without separate bank accounts in each country. By consolidating accounts, FX and payments, it helps businesses cut costs and friction on international transactions.
content.meta: Payset offers multi-currency business accounts, virtual IBANs and FX. Discover Payset and other Neobanks on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
